setup: The graph of $y = \sin([[b]]x)$ is one period of a repeating wave, and you are asked for its period in degrees.

steps.say: A coefficient inside the angle compresses the graph horizontally. One full cycle happens when the argument $[[b]]x$ advances by a full turn, so the input advances by a full turn divided by [[b]].
Dividing 360 degrees by [[b]] gives [[answer]] degrees, and that is the smallest positive angle after which the values repeat.
